employees.quote: Navient had 670 employees as of December 31, 2025.

notes: Loan servicing outsourced to a third party in 2024 (Q2 2026 supplemental), so customer-facing servicing staff sit with the vendor; headcount fell 68% year over year.

employees.quote: approximately 9,300 team members who show up every day committed to our customers and our mission

triggers.detail: you're holding an operating expense ratio guide of about 6.6% for the year while managed receivables grow 7%
triggers.quote: We are maintaining our OpEx ratio guide of approximately 6.6%, for the year.

triggers.detail: you've rolled an internal AI tool to 9,000-plus team members to drive efficiency and speed up customer service
triggers.quote: We have built an internal AI tool that gives our more than 9 thousand team members information they need, like policies or procedures, at their fingertips in an intuitive conversational manner driving efficiency and speeding up customer service.

notes: Central Operations and customer service roles posted for Evansville IN, Fort Mill SC, London KY and Tempe AZ, no public site headcount.

triggers.detail: your customer contact centers were shut for a month after the July cyberattack and only targeted reopening by mid-August
triggers.quote: We expect to have basic servicing up and running for the majority of our businesses, including the reopening of our customer contact centers, by our mid-August target.

triggers.detail: you're still working a backlog of Life and AD&D claims filed before July 11 and don't expect most paid until mid-September
triggers.quote: We expect to complete payment of most Life and AD&D claims that were submitted prior to July 11, 2026, by mid-September.

notes: Mutual with no SEC headcount disclosure and no employee count on its about, careers, media kit or 2025 annual report pages; retirement, life and annuity call centers confirmed; newsroom banner dated Sep 11 2026 says systems are still being restored.
